value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) treats the persistent siren_ringing condition as a new trigger on every step it remains true. The task says to turn the siren off each time it *starts* ringing. Use a one-step start event as the trigger, not siren_ringing.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(served_while_ringing, switch_toggled) only requires turning off the siren after a serve that occurs while it is already ringing. The task requires turning it off each time the siren starts, whether or not a serve occurs. Use the siren-start event as the trigger and require switch_toggled in response.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(served_while_ringing, switch_toggled) misses the task’s trigger. The task says to turn the siren off each time it starts ringing, but served_while_ringing only becomes true when an order is served during a ring. Use siren_ringing as the condition and switch_toggled as the response.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is owed again on every step the siren remains on, so toggling the switch later does not satisfy the task unless it happens on the last ringing step. The task requires turning the siren off after it starts ringing. Use Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) only if the proposition marks the start event; with the given propositions, the clause cannot express that requirement correctly.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) does not capture “each time the siren starts ringing.” Since siren_ringing persists until silenced, the rule is owed again on every step it remains on; toggling the switch ends the ring but does not satisfy a switch_toggled requirement on the final ringing step. Use the start-of-ring event as the trigger, or otherwise encode one switch toggle for each ring.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires a toggle on or after every step the siren is ringing. The task requires turning it off each time the siren starts, not toggling the switch while it is already silent. Because siren_ringing is a lasting condition, this Response can remain owed after the siren is turned off and requires a later toggle. Use a rule tied to the start event; the declared propositions do not include a siren-start event.
